reviews.title: Hume Pod 2.0
reviews.text: So far I’m actually not liking the upgraded Hume Pod. I honestly see no overall plus side over my Body Pod 1.0, if anything I see downsides. With my old pod even with the sensor underneath glass, it read my metrics virtually without issue. With the pod 2.0, I basically have to drench my hands and feet with water for it to read my metrics, otherwise I get the error that says it can’t read them, and this is with the sensor now on the outside. This happened on day one and continues now. The very first time I used it, I used my pod 1.0 first (no issue), then immediately went to the pod 2.0 (error). So far, really not the best investment if you already own the pod 1.0. And be ready to wet those hands and feet. And also, getting help is a nightmare, straight to the AI assistant which is the worst thing ever. They offered my a partial refund for my inconvenience, but because I didn’t have the order number at the time, and couldn’t even remember which email I used for it, that was a wash. I did eventually find my product order through Apple wallet, but yea, couldn’t get the offer again. Definitely not pleased.

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service – Still Waiting for My Order
reviews.text:
I ordered the Hume Band on October 15, 2026, and after more than two weeks, I still haven’t received my order.

I paid over $250 for this product, and honestly, the customer service has been absolutely terrible. I have no clear information about the status of my shipment or when I can expect to receive it.

Every time I try to contact customer support, I only get automated responses from a chatbot. There is no real person available to help, no clear answers, and no phone number where I can actually speak to someone.

It’s extremely frustrating to spend this much money on a product and be left completely in the dark.

I can’t even review the quality of the Hume Band itself because I STILL HAVEN’T RECEIVED IT!

At this point, I’m extremely disappointed with this company and its lack of communication and customer support.

I would not recommend ordering from Hume Health until they seriously improve their shipping process and customer service.

reviews.title: Helpful tracking, but too many upsells and little encouragement
reviews.text:
Hume has helped me see progress beyond my weight, and that’s motivated me some, but for what this scale costs, the overall experience falls short. I’ve been using the scale consistently for four months.

My biggest request for the developers: celebrate progress. Even when my numbers improve, the app keeps emphasizing “high” and “very high.” I have to dig through comparisons to see how far I’ve come. Keep the health information accurate, but acknowledge improvement instead of constantly reminding me how far I still have to go.

Too much of the value feels tied to a monthly subscription and buying the separate band. After paying so much for the scale, needing more purchases to get the full experience makes it feel gimmicky.

Several people also bought Hume on my recommendation, but Hume wouldn’t give me referral credit because they didn’t remember to use my code. That left a bad taste after I’d encouraged others to buy it.

Useful numbers, but the extra costs, lack of encouragement, and referral experience make it hard to give a higher rating.

reviews.title: Band stopped charging and so did customer service
reviews.text:
Edit: It took two weeks to receive a reply from anyone from Hume after my band stopped charging. I received a text message from Hume two weeks after my email and when I advised that I’d sent an email to support about the band not working, and nothing had been resolved, she told me she could not do anything about it and I would have to wait for their reply. On Friday, October 16, I received an email from Hume asking me to send a video of the band on the charger. I had previously followed all the steps (wiped the back of the band, tried a different cord, tried a different outlet - a friend’s band charged on my cord, but mine was completely dead). On Monday, October 19, I received an email stating they closed my case because I didn’t send the video. I was out of town. They didn’t respond to me for ten days with a canned “sorry for the delay we are busy” email and then don’t even allow me a two non-business day response before closing my case. 



I enjoy having all the stats to review because it helps me stay focused on my goals and lets me know just where I am in my health journey. Seeing the stats and comparing them with how I mentally and physically feel on a daily basis, gives me enough data to understand if I’m moving in the right direction with my goals or if there are additional changes I need to make.

I shall persevere for another month or two but will probably consign the band to the bin as it doesn’t suit my needs for heart health monitoring.

reviews.title: Tricked Into a Sub?
reviews.text:
I’ve had the Hume Band 1.0 for a while and am having recurring issues with blocks of time with no data and the band thinking I’m sleeping at random times (even while simultaneously tracking steps.) I reached out to Hume support and they gave me some troubleshooting tips. When I tried all of those unsuccessfully, the Hume representative offered to send me a replacement 1.0 band for free, or if I chose to buy a year subscription to the app, I could get upgraded to the 2.0 band at no cost. I opted for the 2.0, and sent all of the requested information, including a copy of my bill for the subscription from Apple.

That was the last I heard from Hume. I have sent several follow up emails and also tried to reach someone through the app. I feel like I was tricked into subscribing. Now I’ve paid an additional $100 and still have a band that says I sleep 3 or 11 hours a day. I have no idea if the other readings can be trusted. I was getting responses every 4 days or so until after I made the requisite subscription purchase. Then I never heard from them again.

reviews.title: Inconsistent data
reviews.text: The data between the different sections of the app do not track together. For example the sleep and activity data do not go to the health report. Despite daily use, the health report section says not enough data and recommends consistent use. The company keeps promising the issue will be fixed with updates but after each one so far the issue still has not been fixed. Sometimes the band looses connectivity at night and my step count with the band compared to the Apple Watch is very different most days. Apple Watch showing a lot more steps. I don’t expect them to be the exact same daily but figured the data would be closer. With the band losing connectivity at night makes me think it does the same thing during the day. The band is tight so I know it’s not moving around losing connection with my wrist. I like the warranty part offered. When I first got my band it didn’t track steps at all but the company did replace it. Customer service has been good as well. I just wished I could believe the data it is giving.

reviews.title: If you’re not thin don’t bother
reviews.text:
Updating since I finally got a response. Apparently there is a known issue that the app doesn’t recognize body composition unless you score a “B” or above and it is going to be several WEEKS (their emphasis) before the issue will be resolved. So unless you’re already thin don’t bother getting this to try to help you improve your health. No offer to suspend the charges for the service until they fix the issue or anything just the BS “we apologize for the inconvenience”. I still haven’t decided if I’m going to continue or demand all of my money back since apparently my body type isn’t supported by their service.


Since apparently you can’t get a human on the phone or by chat or email I guess the only way to get a response is by giving a bad review. I have weighed almost daily on the pod and wear my band constantly but the app shows missing data and isn’t giving me proper reports. I have emailed several times and gotten only the automated response in return. I’m considering disputing the service charges since I am not getting what I paid for and have received no help from customer service.

reviews.title: DECEPTIVE "FREE TRIAL" TRAP & $$$ YOU WON’T GET BACK
reviews.text:
The app endlessly bombarded my iPad Pro with full-screen "Plus member" pop-ups. The entire bottom half of these screens advertised a "30-day free trial" in big, bold letters.
I finally gave in just to test the features. Instead of the promised free trial, I was immediately charged the full $99 annual subscription fee, plus tax! I immediately canceled the subscription in my settings and requested a refund from Apple, thinking it would be a simple fix. Apple denied the first request, asked for more information, and after I submitted it, they hit me with "This is not eligible for a refund. This decision is final." Not only did I not get my money back, but the 30-day trial that originally showed as canceled one month from the order date suddenly changed to show as canceled one year from the order date. Apple completely erased the 30 days and started the one-year clock from day one.
When I reached out to Hume customer support for help with the deceptive charge, the representative was completely dismissive, blamed Apple for the billing trap, and offered zero solutions. Do not trust their marketing, as they use predatory dark patterns to trick you into an immediate charge, and neither Hume nor Apple will give you your money back.
As if all of this wasn’t enough, the physical band I originally purchased for my 82-year-old mother with a heart condition was completely unwearable. I bought it based on how they sell it, claiming it can track everything and even warn you days before you h

reviews.title: Scam company - avoid
reviews.text:
I had previously been a user of FitTrack and had paid for one of their scales which worked brilliantly. Then Hume purchased them and put everything I had already paid for, including my own personal data, behind  pay wall. They then made the scales I bought useless by blocking all the features I had already paid for. The final straw has come that the Hume app no longer works with the scales I already own and every single time I open the app, even if glimpsing away to another screen on my phone, it pushes me to their website to buy THEIR scales, which are the same thing I already own. 

Their support has been absolutely useless anf all the negative reviews I’ve seen back up my experiences. 

This is an absolute scam of a company and I hope they shut down as we don’t need companies like this. Avoid like the plague

reviews.title: Fix the problems
reviews.text: Waiting six months for developer support. Actually about six years but it has been specifically promised for six months by first line support. I don't think Hume has any interest in solving multi-user and sync errors.I'm fed up taking 20-30 min to weigh myself because the scales can't talk to my phone despite being connected. Typically I may need to delete the device and reconnect 2 to 5 x remove and reinstall the app, restart phone before it finally gets the message. Sometimes it’s just a few reconnects. Was fine till we added a second user. Weight can increase by 0.5kg on reconnection (with the original matching manual scales) and according to Hume my wife has mid 20s fat content but super elite athlete fat content of 11/12 on her legs. No visual evidence of this!  Can live with that foible but a company not even interested in solving a serious connection problem after forcing me to upgrade to an expensive new model winds me up. The problem goes back to the fit-track. Don’t buy this if you plan to have more than one user.

reviews.title: Has potential
reviews.text: They really need to work on the software on the UX side. First off, if you forget to wear the device or it dies for one night, your entire report gets thrown off, up until recently the app didn’t even show battery percentage on the band - ridiculous. They need to add a feature to allow for the user to input sleep or make changes to sleep data based on reality or when the device doesn’t track properly (happens often) so for example if the band says I only slept 3hrs and I know I slept 7, software doesn’t allow to add in the extra hours manually - or pause the sleep tracking for a night when I know I won’t be wearing the band. Overall the scores and reports don’t really mean much, also the band doesn’t seem to track heart rate without a constant manual sync/refresh - which means there’s no way to alert the user if the heart rate is way out of bounds. The graphs have no zoom ability and no way to get refined/ micro level data. The email response from tech support is all AI generated and scripted. You will never be a real success if you start off running your company like this. Get it together! It’s not too late! $200 is not cheap for this tech.

reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text: Hume band often does not record my sleep accurately, and then lowers my score due to poor sleep.  Hume gave me an F in body comp a couple of months ago and its always an F now, even though all my sub categories are standard or good, which doesnt make sense.  Hume changed my body composition to an F, from a C all the way back to the beginning of my memebership, so I have all F’s, across the board.  Then Hume tanked my hydration levels down to “very low” due to an update “bug” that seems to be recovering slowly?  but I can’t trust this data now.  Also, Hume told me for over 24 hours that I had to sign up for Hume plus to get my data, when I’ve been a member since I got it in December of 2025, then it came back.  it seems to me that something that is advertised to be as accurate as a dexa scan, should be far more accurate and reliable.  Hume does not inspire confidence and customer service is a joke.  I’ve read lots of bad reviews and posts since I’ve had mine, and they are not good.  Many people experiencing the same issues and no help from Hume!  I was going to get my adult daughter a band AND a scale for her birthday, but I dont have enough confidence in the products to buy more.  Sorry Hume, do better, just like you tell me, daily.  F is your score until you achieve more accuracy with mine.  As much as these cost, plus the annual membership, there should be a much higher satisfaction return on investment.  improving any of these areas will improve your rating.

reviews.title: Undecided
reviews.text: I was in an accident and had a pelvic external fixator on because I fractured my pelvis. I bought the human band, hoping it would show my progress. It wasn’t showing anything. It told me I was bad even when I started exercising.. Then I realized I probably needed to get the Hume band in order to get the overall picture. After I got the band, it wasn’t tracking my steps decently. I wore my Fitbit just to see. Fitbit was very good at tracking my steps and the human band did not. It was always like a couple thousand steps lower, which is a lot. I really I’m not happy with the way that you can read it. It’s just so complicated to me. It’s very confusing. It tells me that I am severely low on water and I drink a lot of water. I drink more than half my weight in water. I don’t even know what to do. Even though I have been exercising walking after being in a wheelchair for three months, it still doesn’t show that I’m very and gives me a low score. It’s actually kind of defeating. I really wish the charts were easier to read. It doesn’t tell you exactly how you have deep sleep, which is what I really like to see. Overall, I’m just not really that impressed..

reviews.title: Hydration stats broken at the moment
reviews.text:
Overall, the scales work for me.  For the first couple of weeks I had synchronisation issues, and the Bluetooth connection failed way too much.  That seems to have settled now.  Which was my main issue, so I’ve increased my rating up from the original 1*.  Two things bother me now:
1) No data is stored in the cloud, so you can’t access it from any other device that the device you run this app on.  Seems mad in this day and age!  The folks in support are helpful though, and will send me a spreadsheet with my data when I need it :).
2) the hydration algorithm is clearly broken.  I started at a sensible %ge, but it has dropped 1%-1.5% a day.  Soon, it will be saying I am below 20% water.  I’m pretty sure that is wrong XD.  On the basis the first measure it took was 60%, the consistency of the drop suggests they have a bug.  Other stats look more sensible, so I think the scanner is probably fine.  Hopefully they will patch the app soon.

reviews.title: Hume Band Inaccurate
reviews.text:
I purchased both the Hume Pod and the Hume Band to use in conjunction with each other. First off I will say that set up for both devices is a breeze. I have been using both devices consistently for 3 months. I have had zero issues with the hume pod. I love all of the metrics given to track muscle, fat, water and bone density. My huge issue and reason for two stars is the Hume Band. It does not track sleep with any certain consistency. This one inaccuracy throws off every other metric the band reads. Strain, Metabolic Capacity and needed rest are all inaccurate. The health reports and the chronic illness reports are useless without accurate sleep readings. The app does not allow any manual tracking or adjustments for sleep duration. I have tried every which way to wear the band to try and correct the sleep tracking but nothing works. If Hume can’t fix this it’s just a very over priced step counter.

Update: Before going to bed or after having charged it, force close the app and reopen it to re-sync your Hume Band. This fixed the sleep problem for the most part however, being able to manually adjust an inaccurate sleep session would be a full proof fix.

Update: Whatever update they did failed to rectify the sleep tracking issues. In fact it made it worse. I have reduced my rating to 2 stars. Without proper sleep tracking, this app is completely useless. Health scores, metabolic rating, strain tolerance, recovery and chronic illness reports are worthless without proper sleep tr

reviews.title: Rubbish fake reviews on the website
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience with this company. The product arrived faulty and the build quality was extremely poor, it honestly looked like it had just been glued together. All I wanted to do was return the item and get a refund, but instead of sending a return label they kept insisting I troubleshoot the product and try to fix it myself. I made it clear several times that I simply wanted to return it, but they refused unless I paid for the return shipping. Really frustrating service and a very low quality product. I would not buy from this company again.

reviews.title: Connection issues
reviews.text: Connecting to the Hume scale is so inconsistent and terribly designed that the measuring process can sometimes take up to 15min and other times less than a minute.

reviews.title: Do Not Recommend
reviews.text: Purchased Plus subscription via Apple within the app at the end of August 2025. Never received the reports that I was supposed to receive. Noticed some variations to the app and data not showing in the app that should have been there. Contacted support and was advised there was an issue with my account and that I would need to create a new account under a different email address. Did what was directed even though I was told the app would be transferred to my new account. It’s now almost February 2026, subscription still has not been added to my new account, refreshed every time I was contacted that the account was updated. Logged out of app to push a hard reset and now cannot login to the app with the message “Error! User data is null.” In early November Hume changed the way the app/scale deliver measurements which does not separate male from female which distorts data. Very disappointed in the product, the service/support, and the company. I am unable to receive a refund through Apple because it’s been too long and was too long before I caught the issues and Hume says that since I purchased the subscription through the app they cannot refund. Waste of money. I do not recommend any Hume products.

reviews.title: Paid subscription, unusable product, weeks of stalled support
reviews.text:
This app has been unusable with my Hume Body Pod. After the first few days, it stopped recording any weight or body data, even though it showed the device as connected. I contacted support and followed every instruction: resets, re-pairing, reinstalling, and sending screenshots and device info.

Responses were slow, and I had to keep following up. Meanwhile, my paid Plus subscription continued. I missed the entire free trial while troubleshooting an issue that was never resolved. As I wrote to support, “It’s now getting boring chasing you up repeatedly for something I have paid for.”

For an app tied to a paid hardware device and subscription, this level of reliability and support is not acceptable.

reviews.title: Very basic app
reviews.text: I accidentally signed up for the plus version (tried to activate the free trial twice after problems getting set up). But thought I’d give it a go. It’s not worth it. The biggest issue is the app doesn’t synch active calories with apple health so despite all my efforts burning 400+ active calories a day it’s telling me my health score of low. The whole point of an app is the motivation of seeing a metric improve. The scales are good and for basic fat % metrics are worth it but don’t bother paying for the “plus”…total waste of money. There are some classes to do that don’t involve any use of weights so are quite boring and not likely to build muscle anytime soon and there is no link to the metrics so you can do 10 classes in one day but it will still say you are “sedentary”. The two stars are for the basic app. The bits that do work. The 3 missing stars are for the £79 of value I’m not getting for the plus version.

reviews.title: Mostly good but
reviews.text: The app and scale combo is really good and it gives a lot of information(that does sometimes seems really inconsistent) but the band is really bad compared to other options. It’s way more expensive for a band that doesn’t have good live updates, disconnects and misses data, and the band that you use to wear it is really stupid. You can adjust it but then it recommends cutting it to reduce slack. If you do that though you run into the problem I got where if the band doesn’t stay it will pop off.( it doesn’t use holes to keep it from changing size just a loop. The band is not worth the stupid high price it gives some information that for some people might be good but in every other aspect it’s so much worse. The stress tracking stops working at times. It’s hard to know if the band is even on and working without the app so, if you are working and can’t check your phone you have no idea if it’s actually working. If you want to get into fitness and you want to use Hume, just get the scale and get a Fitbit it’s a way better deal for 99% of people.

reviews.title: Worked for 3 tries
reviews.text: This thing is the worst!!! Paid so much money for this scale so that I could track my body composition and this app won’t ever communicate with the scale anymore. It constantly throws error codes for not being able to communicate even with my scale right next to my phone. The scale measures everything, it’ll take me all the way through the end of the measuring on the app, but right when it tries to sync that data to display it on the app, boom, error. No matter how many times I try and no matter how many times I delete and redownload or reset my scale. It’s extremely frustrating!!! It only worked in the beginning for about 3 readings and now it’s just a complete dud! I would’ve gone with a much cheaper scale without the body composition data if I knew this app was so terrible. The scale itself doesn’t allow me to see the data other than weight and heart rate. So it’s not like I can use that to see it. And now I’m out of the return window, of course, because that’s how things go these days. Last only long enough so you can’t return it. If you see this before you buy the scale, DO NOT BUY!!!!
